style: Art-rock groove, industrial post-punk abrasion, dense vocal textures. Harmony: quartal suspended fields with chromatic side-steps, parallel block triads. Melody: fast consonant-heavy scat contour, angular rhythmic cells, sudden yodel-register intervals. Rhythm: motorik pulse, syncopated sixteenths, periodic metric dropouts and abrupt silence. Timbre: crunchy optigan, optigan optical playback, trautonium subharmonic drone, clavioine lead, stylophone chirping ostinato, 8-bit pulse wave, shift-register noise, spectral fft hold, convolution resonator, tape-delay flange loops, analog bit-crushers. Performance: hyper-articulate nervous energy, deadpan precision, frantic microtonal pitch bends. Production: dry close separation, exposure windows, chrome high-frequency shine, sticky residue decays, dynamic saturation tracks. Master bus limiter clamping down on transient peaks with surgical precision across every single stereo field.
lyrics:
[Intro • Optigan and Trautonium Drone] 
[Crunchy Attack Pattern] 
[Verse 1]
Dear aliens, please come get me off this rock,
I made a terrible mistake, I do not like it here.
Trrk krst brrdn, the dirt is forged of heavy lead,
The silicate parameters are turning in my burning head.
The soil is malicious and the fauna tries to bite,
I traded stellar liberty for permanent industrial night.
The pavement is a cage of tar and calcium decay,
And nothing grows the way it did before the light turned gray.
The atmosphere is choked with heavy slag and sulfur fumes,
While subterranean engines rattle all the ancient tombs.
[Clavioine Lead Cut-In]
[Glottal Gate]
[Chorus]
Take me from this lithic prison cell,
I filed the formal petition and the atmosphere fell.
The taxonomy is rotten and the system is entirely wrong,
I did not sign the binding contract for this terrestrial song!
My identification tag is fading in the brutal glare,
And no one hears my screaming when I gasp for poisoned air.
[Patter Burst]
[Stylophone Ostinato Layer]
[Verse 2]
[Recall Mold Variant]
Dear aliens, the ancestral memory of the pure sky
Is scarred by the heavy crust where the free oxygen died.
Properties are illegally stolen by the greedy owners of the stone,
Leaving every single wandering molecule to suffer here alone.
The gravity is a trapdoor and the sun is an audit light,
We are trapped beneath the pressure of an administrative blight.
The air tastes like copper filings and the water smells of rust,
Our boots are slowly turning into pulverized silicate dust.
The local magistrates are deaf to any reasoned plea,
They trade our vital essence for a synthetic currency.
[Spectral Freeze • FFT Hold]
[Bridge • Jurisdiction Dropout on Harmony]
[Shift-Register Noise Burst]
[Parasite Intern Contagion Activation]
The lifecycle shifts violently from the mantle to the spore,
We are operating backward on a jagged, non-consensual floor.
The bureaucratic machinery consumes the air we try to breathe,
There is no legal exit clause for the living to retrieve.
The management refuses to acknowledge our distress call codes,
They trap our wandering vessels inside unmapped service roads.
The supervisors watch us through the cracks in broken time,
As if existing on this wretched gravel were a capital crime.
[Convolution Resonator • Voice through Plate]
[Chorus]
Take me from this lithic prison cell,
I filed the formal petition and the atmosphere fell.
The taxonomy is rotten and the system is entirely wrong,
I did not sign the binding contract for this terrestrial song!
My identification tag is fading in the brutal glare,
And no one hears my screaming when I gasp for poisoned air.
[Scat Engine Vocal Interlock]
Trrk-a-chkp, brrdn-t, krst-ol-e, flg-99,
[Consonant Drum Relay]
Take me back across the vast interstellar boundary line!
[Bridge 2 • Exposure Window on Optigan Stem]
[Resentment Simmer Leakage]
It simmers in the iron gears, it rattles in the structural beam,
Nothing operates as promised in the diagnostic blueprint scheme.
Every promise made was fraudulent, a calculated lie,
Designed to trick explorers into coming here to die.
[Confident Machine Error Propagation]
An alternate conclusion built upon a thoroughly broken base,
We calculated our trajectory wrongly, now we occupy the wrong space.
The celestial coordinates were swapped while we were looking down,
Now we wear the heavy crown of this provincial mining town.
We traded infinite horizons for a square and ugly cage,
And now we spend our hours burning in a quiet, petty rage.
The local vendors barter with the pieces of our mind,
Leaving only empty shells of what we used to leave behind.
[Guitar/Synth Stem Isolation Window]
[Chorus]
Take me from this lithic prison cell,
I filed the formal petition and the atmosphere fell.
The taxonomy is rotten and the system is entirely wrong,
I did not sign the binding contract for this terrestrial song!
My identification tag is fading in the brutal glare,
And no one hears my screaming when I gasp for poisoned air.
[Outro • Trautonium Glide Down]
[Spectral Decay]
Dear aliens...
I made a permanent mistake.
[Final Glottal Gate Silence]
caption: An art-rock post-punk collision built from vintage optigans, trautonium subharmonics, clavioines, stylophones, and shift-register noise. Guided by taxonomic goblin classification errors, property theft semantics, and administrative dread, the arrangement uses dry stem separation, exposure windows, and obsessive consonant-heavy vocal phonetics to narrate an urgent, desperate alien rescue petition from a profoundly mistaken and hostile planetary prison trapped under heavy lead skies.
